utterance: Chloe, your urine test shows signs of a bladder infection, and your temperature and kidney check are normal, so this looks like a simple bladder infection. The pregnancy test is negative. I've prescribed an antibiotic called trimethoprim — one tablet at night for 3 days. It won't affect your pill. Drink plenty of water, and paracetamol can help with the discomfort. As you're sexually active without condoms, I've also sent off a routine urine test for chlamydia and gonorrhoea, which can cause similar symptoms — we'll call you in a couple of days with results. Please come back or seek urgent care if you develop fever or shivers, pain in your back or side, vomiting, blood in the urine, feel very unwell, or if you're not improving within 48 hours or symptoms come back after finishing — then we'd send a urine culture. If you get a rash, stop the tablets and let us know.
